description: BlueSky DMs (chat.bsky.*): list_convos, read messages in a convo, send a message (by convoId or members), or mark_read. Returns compact JSON.

action.description: list_convos = your DM conversations; messages = messages in a convo; send = send a message; mark_read = mark a convo read.

convoId.description: Conversation ID (messages/mark_read; send if not using members).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a prior call. Omit for the first page.

maxItems.description: Auto-paginate (follow cursors) until this many items are gathered in ONE call. Default = one page.

members.description: For send: handles/DIDs to open/find a convo with, instead of convoId.

sessionId.description: Browser session ID. If omitted, auto-selects the only open session.

tabId.description: Target a specific tab within the session (the bsky.app tab). Auto-resolved if omitted.

name: bluesky_dm
